_schema_note: AGGRESSIVE breaker schema. The SAFE breaker (automation/state/circuit-breaker.json) uses a fully divergent vocabulary (C9 symmetry trap). Field-name mapping AGGRESSIVE -> SAFE: tripped->tripped (SAME, both present); trip_reason->tripped_reason; tripped_at_et->tripped_at; equity_start_of_day->starting_equity_today; equity_current->current_equity; loss_pct->(no direct equivalent; safe stores daily_loss_limit_dollars/_pct as the LIMIT, this file stores realized loss %). Today each heartbeat reads ONLY its own breaker and mostly only `.tripped` (present in both), so nothing breaks — but any CROSS-ACCOUNT consumer must use this mapping or it will read null on the other file. Do NOT rename the live keys here (the aggressive heartbeat gate reads them).
